classifications.authority_or_basis: Abracadabra protocol documentation describing collateralized borrowing and MIM minting

notes: MIM is minted through collateralized Abracadabra cauldrons. Ordinary MIM holders do not receive a direct claim against the protocol operator; borrower collateral release occurs through debt repayment, while other holders generally depend on protocol or secondary-market liquidity. Operational separation refers to smart-contract collateral accounting and is not a legal segregation or safety conclusion.

classifications.jurisdiction: Decentralized / Fei Protocol and Tribe DAO governance
classifications.authority_or_basis: Fei Protocol design documentation and the executed TIP-121c final-redemption governance package

notes: The recorded holder right is the historical final-redemption mechanism authorized through Fei governance, not a direct corporate claim. The profile ends at the reviewed 2022-09-22 wind-down package; current contract availability remains a separate operational question. Operational separation describes protocol-controlled value and governance-controlled contracts, not legal bankruptcy protection.
